title: Gyuwambler Jiko Chuushinha: Tokyo Mahjongland
native_title: ぎゅわんぶらあ自己中心派 ～トーキョー・マージャンランド～
overview:
The gambler's promised land - a dark shadow lurks in Tokyo Mahjongland!!

Step into Tokyo Mahjongland, the place every gambler dreams of visiting, and sit down at the table against the eccentric cast of Masayuki Katayama's Gambler Jiko Chuushinha manga. Four-player mahjong pits you against a crowd of computer opponents, and every character speaks with full voice acting.

- 56 characters to face at the table
- Based on the Mega-CD Tokyo Mahjongland, with strengthened computer opponents
- One player, with memory backup

ぎゅわんぶらあ憧れの地、東京マージャンランドに潜む黒い影!!
